sources.title: Stanford CS 329X | Human-Centered LLMs
sources.snippet: Welcome! This course will provide an overview of human-centered methodologies specifically tailored for large language models (LLMs). Topics include human-centered design, alignment, preference tuning, personalization, UI and HCI integration, techniques for privacy and risk measurement, as well as applications in creativity and future of work.
